rows.ve: Shumisani rekhodo dzaṋu kana u anganyela ho ṱolwaho henefho. Zwivhalo zwi siho zwi dzula zwi sa ḓivhei. Makumba, ḽithara na kg zwi vhulungwa zwo fhambana.

rows.english: Choose one product and one month. Expected means your estimate; actual means what was produced. Adding the same product, month and status replaces its previous figure.
rows.zu: Khetha umkhiqizo owodwa nenyanga eyodwa. Okulindelwe kusho isilinganiso sakho; okwenzekile kusho lokho okukhiqiziwe. Ukufaka umkhiqizo ofanayo, inyanga nesimo kuthatha indawo yenani lakho langaphambili.
rows.st: Kgetha sehlahiswa se le seng le kgwedi e le nngwe. E lebeletsweng e bolela khakanyo ya hao; e etsahetseng e bolela se hlahisitsweng. Ho kenya sehlahiswa, kgwedi le boemo bo tshwanang ho nkela palo ya pele sebaka.
rows.ts: Hlawula xikumiwa xin’we ni n’hweti yin’we. Lexi languteriweke xi vula mpimanyeto wa wena; lexi veke kona xi vula leswi humelerisiweke. Ku engetela xikumiwa, n’hweti ni xiyimo leswi fanaka swi siva nhlayo ya swona ya khale.
rows.ve: Nangani tshibveledzwa tshithihi na ṅwedzi muthihi. Ho lavhelelwaho zwi amba u anganyela haṋu; ho iteaho zwi amba zwo bveledzwaho. U dzhenisa tshibveledzwa, ṅwedzi na tshiimo zwi fanaho zwi dzhiela tshivhalo tsha kale vhudzulo.

rows.english: Record food you have kept, bought or carried from an earlier harvest. Choose its months yourself. The plan does not work out a safe shelf life or a preservation recipe.
rows.zu: Rekhoda ukudla okugcinile, okuthengile noma okusele esivunweni sangaphambili. Zikhethele izinyanga zakho. Uhlelo alubali isikhathi okuphephile ukukugcina noma indlela yokukulondoloza.
rows.st: Rekota dijo tseo o di bolokileng, o di rekileng kapa tse setseng kotulong ya pele. Ikgethele dikgwedi tsa tsona. Moralo ha o bale nako e bolokehileng ya ho di boloka kapa mokgwa wa ho di baballa.
rows.ts: Rhekhoda swakudya leswi u swi hlayiseke, u swi xaveke kumbe leswi saleke eka ntshovelo wa khale. Hlawula tin’hweti ta swona hi wexe. Pulani a yi hlayeli nkarhi lowu swi nga hlayisiwaka hi vuhlayiseki kumbe ndlela yo swi hlayisa.
rows.ve: Rekhodani zwiḽiwa zwe na vhulunga, na renga kana zwo salaho kha khaṋo ya kale. Ḓinangeleni miṅwedzi yazwo. Pulane a i vhali tshifhinga tshine zwa nga vhulungwa zwo tsireledzea kana nḓila ya u zwi vhulunga.

rows.english: One food counts once, even if it is both fresh and frozen. These are planned or recorded windows, not kilograms or meals. Regional reference seasons and undated plants or housing stay outside these totals.
rows.zu: Ukudla okukodwa kubalwa kanye, noma kukusha futhi kuqandisiwe. Lezi izikhathi ezihleliwe noma ezirekhodiwe, hhayi amakhilogremu noma ukudla kokudla kanye. Izikhathi zesifunda eziyizinkomba nezitshalo noma izindlu zezilwane ezingakabhalelwa izinsuku azifakwa kulezi zibalo eziphelele.
rows.st: Mofuta o le mong wa dijo o balwa hang, leha o le foreshe hape o hoamisitswe. Tsena ke dinako tse rerilweng kapa tse rekotilweng, eseng dikhilograma kapa dijo tsa nako e le nngwe. Dinako tsa tshupiso tsa lebatowa le dimela kapa matlo a diphoofolo a se nang matsatsi ha di kenngwe dipalong tsena tsohle.
rows.ts: Swakudya swin’we swi hlayiwa kan’we, hambi swi ri leswintshwa ni leswi gwitsirisiweke. Leyi i minkarhi leyi pulaniweke kumbe leyi rhekhodiweke, a hi tikhilogiramu kumbe swakudya swa nkarhi wun’we. Tinguva ta xikombo ta xifundza ni swimila kumbe tindlu ta swifuwo leswi nga riki na masiku a swi katsiwi eka mintsengo leyi.
rows.ve: Tshakha nthihi ya zwiḽiwa i vhalwa luthihi, naho i ntswa nahone yo xwatuwaho. Izwi ndi zwifhinga zwo pulanwaho kana zwo rekhodiwaho, a si khilogireme kana zwiḽiwa zwa tshifhinga tshithihi. Khalaṅwaha dza tshiko dza dzingu na zwimela kana zwifhaṱo zwa zwifuwo zwi si na maḓuvha a zwi katelwi kha ṱhanganyelo idzi.

rows.english: Food in store follows each crop’s sourced storage conditions. Freezing, drying, fermentation and other processing enter only through dated stock records. A harvest does not automatically create preserved food.
rows.zu: Ukudla okugciniwe kulandela izimo zokugcina zesitshalo ngasinye ezicashunwe emthonjeni. Ukuqandisa, ukomisa, ukuvutshelwa nokunye ukucubungula kufakwa kuphela ngamarekhodi okudla okugciniwe anezinsuku. Isivuno asenzi ukudla okulondoloziwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
rows.st: Dijo tse polokelong di latela maemo a polokelo a sejalo ka seng a tswang mohloding. Ho hoamisa, ho omisa, ho bedisa le ditshebetso tse ding di kenngwa feela ka direkoto tsa dijo tse bolokilweng tse nang le matsatsi. Kotulo ha e etse dijo tse baballetsweng ka boyona.
rows.ts: Swakudya swa le vuhlayiselweni swi landzela swiyimo swo hlayisa swa xibyariwa xin’wana ni xin’wana leswi humaka eka xihlovo. Ku gwitsirisa, ku omisa, maendlelo ya mbiriso ni maendlelo man’wana yo lulamisa swi katsiwa ntsena hi tirhekhodo ta swakudya leswi hlayisiweke leti nga ni masiku. Ntshovelo a wu endli swakudya leswi hlayisiweke hi woxe.
rows.ve: Zwiḽiwa zwo vhulungwaho zwi tevhela nyimele dza u vhulunga dza tshiliṅwa tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe dzi bvaho kha tshiko. U xwatula, u omisa, maitele a mbiliso na maṅwe maitele a u shandukisa zwiḽiwa zwi katelwa fhedzi nga rekhodo dza zwiḽiwa zwo vhulungwaho dzi re na maḓuvha. Khaṋo a i iti zwiḽiwa zwo vhulungwaho nga yoṱhe.

rows.st: Ha ho direkoto tsa dijo tse bolokilweng tse fanweng. Ho fumaneha ha tsona ha ho tsejwe. Kerafo ena e sebedisa feela dinako tsa kotulo tse tshwailweng le dinako tsa polokelo ya dijalo tse tswang mohloding.
rows.ts: Ku hava tirhekhodo ta swakudya leswi hlayisiweke leti nyikiweke. Ku kumeka ka swona a ku tiveki. Girafu leyi yi tirhisa ntsena minkarhi ya ntshovelo leyi funghiweke ni minkarhi yo hlayisa swibyariwa leyi humaka eka xihlovo.
rows.ve: A hu na rekhodo dza zwiḽiwa zwo vhulungwaho dzo ṋewaho. U wanala hazwo a hu ḓivhei. Girafu iyi i shumisa fhedzi zwifhinga zwa khaṋo zwo swaiwaho na zwifhinga zwa u vhulunga zwiliṅwa zwi bvaho kha tshiko.

rows.st: Ditekanyetso tsa potoloho yohle ya sejalo, di hlophisitswe ka kgwedi eo ho kga ho qalang ka yona. Bara ke potoloho yohle, eseng dikhilograma tse kotutsweng kgweding eo.
rows.ts: Mimpimo ya xirhendzevutana hinkwaxo xa xibyariwa, yi hleriwe hi n’hweti leyi ku kha ku sungulaka ha yona. Bara i xirhendzevutana hinkwaxo, a hi tikhilogiramu leti tshoveriweke eka n’hweti yoleyo.
rows.ve: Mipimo ya mutevhe woṱhe wa tshiliṅwa, yo kuvhanganywaho nga ṅwedzi une u kaṋa ha thoma ngawo. Bara ndi mutevhe woṱhe, a si khilogireme dzo kaṋwaho kha ṅwedzi uyo.

rows.english: Expected and actual monthly quantities you enter. An actual record replaces the expectation for that food and month. Missing weights stay unknown.
rows.zu: Amanani enyanga okulindelwe nawenzekile owafakayo. Irekhodi lokwenzekile lithatha indawo yokulindelwe yalokho kudla kuleyo nyanga. Izisindo ezingekho zihlala zingaziwa.
rows.st: Dipalo tsa kgwedi tse lebeletsweng le tse etsahetseng tseo o di kenyang. Rekoto ya se etsahetseng e nkela se lebeletsweng sebaka bakeng sa dijo tseo le kgwedi eo. Boima bo siyo bo dula bo sa tsejwe.
rows.ts: Tinhlayo ta n’hweti leti languteriweke ni leti veke kona leti u ti nghenisaka. Rhekhodo ya leswi veke kona yi siva leswi languteriweke eka swakudya ni n’hweti yoleyo. Mintiko leyi kayivelaka yi sala yi nga tiveki.
rows.ve: Zwivhalo zwa ṅwedzi zwo lavhelelwaho na zwo iteaho zwine na dzhenisa. Rekhodo ya zwo iteaho i dzhiela zwo lavhelelwaho vhudzulo kha zwiḽiwa izwo na ṅwedzi uyo. Zwileme zwi siho zwi dzula zwi sa ḓivhei.

rows.english: Weights recorded as present in each month. Stored, dried, frozen, fermented and processed foods are stocks; they are not a second harvest.
rows.zu: Izisindo ezirekhodwe njengezikhona enyangeni ngayinye. Ukudla okugciniwe, okomisiwe, okuqandisiwe, okuvutshelwe nokucutshunguliwe kuyizimpahla ezigciniwe; akusona isivuno sesibili.
rows.st: Boima bo rekotilweng bo le teng kgweding ka nngwe. Dijo tse bolokilweng, tse omisitsweng, tse hoamisitsweng, tse bedisitsweng le tse sebetsitsweng ke dijo tse polokelong; ha se kotulo ya bobedi.
rows.ts: Mintiko leyi rhekhodiweke yi ri kona eka n’hweti yin’wana ni yin’wana. Swakudya leswi hlayisiweke, leswi omisiweke, leswi gwitsirisiweke, swa mbiriso ni leswi lulamisiweke i swakudya swa vuhlayiselo; a hi ntshovelo wa vumbirhi.
rows.ve: Zwileme zwo rekhodiwaho sa zwi re hone kha ṅwedzi muṅwe na muṅwe. Zwiḽiwa zwo vhulungwaho, zwo omiswaho, zwo xwatuwaho, zwa mbiliso na zwo shumiwaho ndi zwiḽiwa zwo vhulungwaho; a si khaṋo ya vhuvhili.

rows.english: Crop ground only: food forest, animal areas and ponds are not measured here. The graph caps occupation at each bed’s size; it does not prove that overlapping plantings fit. Keep the plan’s space checks.
rows.zu: Indawo yezitshalo kuphela: ihlathi lokudla, izindawo zezilwane namachibi akukalwa lapha. Igrafu igcina indawo esetshenzisiwe ingeqi usayizi wombhede ngamunye; ayiqinisekisi ukuthi izitshalo ezikhula ngesikhathi esisodwa ziyalingana. Gcina ukuhlolwa kwendawo yohlelo.
rows.st: Sebaka sa dijalo feela: moru wa dijo, dibaka tsa diphoofolo le matamo ha di lekanngwe mona. Kerafo e thibela sebaka se sebedisitsweng ho feta boholo ba bethe ka nngwe; ha e pake hore dijalo tse leng teng ka nako e le nngwe di lekana. Boloka ditlhahlobo tsa sebaka tsa moralo.
rows.ts: Ndhawu ya swibyariwa ntsena: xihlahla xa swakudya, tindhawu ta swifuwo ni madziva a swi pimiwi laha. Girafu yi veka mpimo wa ndhawu leyi tirhisiwaka eka vukulu bya mubedo wun’wana ni wun’wana; a yi tiyisisi leswaku swimila leswi nghenelelanaka hi nkarhi swi nghena endhawini. Hlayisa minkambisiso ya ndhawu ya pulani.
rows.ve: Fhethu ha zwiliṅwa fhedzi: ḓaka ḽa zwiḽiwa, fhethu ha zwifuwo na mativha a zwi pimiwi hafha. Girafu i vhea mukano wa fhethu hu shumiswaho kha vhuhulwane ha mubete muṅwe na muṅwe; a i khwaṱhisedzi uri zwimela zwi tshimbidzanaho nga tshifhinga zwi a lingana. Vhulungani ṱhaṱhuvho dza fhethu dza pulane.

rows.english: The plan as it repeats each year, beds, trees and animals together — the rows switched on in the chart above. This shows whether food comes in, not whether it is enough. Availability bars count crop kinds, not kilograms.
rows.zu: Uhlelo njengoba luphindwa unyaka ngamunye, imibhede, izihlahla nezilwane ndawonye — imigqa evuliwe eshadini elingenhla. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukudla kuyatholakala yini, hhayi ukuthi kwanele yini. Amabha okutholakala abala izinhlobo zezitshalo, hhayi amakhilogremu.
rows.st: Moralo ha o ntse o pheta selemo le selemo, dibethe, difate le diphoofolo mmoho — mela e buletsweng kerafong e ka hodimo. Sena se bontsha hore na dijo di a fumaneha, eseng hore na di lekane. Dibara tsa ho fumaneha di bala mefuta ya dijalo, eseng dikhilograma.
rows.ts: Pulani loko yi vuyelerisiwa lembe rin’wana ni rin’wana, mibedo, misinya ni swifuwo swin’we — mintila leyi pfuriweke eka chati leyi nga laha henhla. Swi komba loko swakudya swi fika, a swi kombi loko swi ringana. Tibara ta ku kumeka ti hlayela mixaka ya swibyariwa, a hi tikhilogiramu.
rows.ve: Pulane musi i tshi dovhololwa ṅwaha muṅwe na muṅwe, mibete, miri na zwifuwo zwoṱhe — mitalo yo vulwaho kha tshati i re afho nṱha. Izwi zwi sumbedza arali zwiḽiwa zwi tshi wanala, a zwi sumbedzi arali zwi tshi eḓana. Mabari a u wanala a vhala tshaka dza zwiliṅwa, a si khilogireme.

rows.st: Ho jala nakong e tlwaelehileng ya lebatowa lena eo dithemphereitjhara tsa sebaka sa hao di e dumellang, betheng e nang le sebaka dikgweding tsa sejalo. “Se kenye moralong” e bula foromo e tlwaelehileng ya ho jala hore o e hlahlobe pele.

rows.ve: U ṱavha kha tshifhinga tsho ḓoweleaho tsha dzingu iḽi tshine mufhiso wa fhethu haṋu wa tshi tendela, kha mubete u re na tshikhala kha miṅwedzi ya tshiliṅwa. “Zwi pulaneni” zwi vula fomo yo ḓoweleaho ya u ṱavha uri ni thome u i ṱola.
